title: Don't Throw Away Your Mistakes | Emotional Animated Short Film
description:
Every time he failed, he crumpled it up and threw it away. A test. A drawing. A team that didn't want him. And a dark voice that kept telling him he was just a pile of mistakes.

Then Grandpa picked up one of those crumpled pages... and showed him what they really were.

Don't throw your mistakes away. Stand on them.

If this hit you, subscribe for more.

#motivation #animation #shortfilm #selfimprovement #nevergiveup
